meaning: Published FNRI estimate of households classified as food secure.
not allowed: Do not interpret as the complement of a different survey's food-insecurity category without matching instrument.

meaning: Published estimate for severe food insecurity.
allowed interpretation: Use only with its original survey instrument, year, and definition.
not allowed: Do not equate to moderate-to-severe FIES or any food insecurity.

meaning: Published ENNS provincial estimate reproduced in the regional plan.
allowed interpretation: Historical reference; validate original FNRI source and instrument.
not allowed: Do not assume comparable to 2015 severe-only estimate.

meaning: Share of families below the official subsistence threshold.
allowed interpretation: Use as a separate food-poverty indicator or predictor/context.
not allowed: Do not label as direct FIES/HFIAS food insecurity.

meaning: Share of persons below the official subsistence threshold.
allowed interpretation: Use as a separate food-poverty indicator or predictor/context.
not allowed: Do not confuse with family-based incidence.
